facts.statement: Attendees at the Dragon*Con panel were shown screenshots detailing the upcoming Goal Time update.
facts.quote: were treated to screenshots detailing the upcoming Goal Time update

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short official news post (titled 'In The Works: Goal Time Screenshots') saying the Free Realms Community Team attended Dragon*Con in Atlanta, GA, where fans attended a special panel and were shown screenshots of the upcoming Goal Time update. The post gives no details of what Goal Time contains beyond its name. The client has a string 'Goal Time Soccer' (id 318), which may relate to this update but the article does not say so.
